description.zh-Hans: 游戏中，你将扮演一位前往幻想城市 LAS 休假的旅客，体验当地盛会"创作节"的氛围，并发掘多年前的创作节上，关于一位创作者的故事。
description.en: In the game, you will play as a tourist visiting the fantasy city LAS for vacation, experiencing the atmosphere of the local festival 'Creation Festival', and discovering the story of a creator from the Creation Festival many years ago.
